title: MLOps: experimentos, registro y serving
continuity_gate: S01-S46 covered; S47 was first missing at execution start.

findings.issue: S47 requires S46, but S46 remains REPAIR_REQUIRED with a P0 known defect.
Canonical estimatedHours is 9 while live public card declares 20h.
CP-N4-B/CF-4 path can go green without the deployable Production Data/ML Platform and immutable integrated evidence required by the roadmap.
S47 restarts provenance as loose strings instead of carrying S44 supply-chain and S46 production-data/lineage artifacts forward.
Run reproducibility is reduced to aggregate metric repeatability plus seed/params, omitting required artifact/dataset/code/environment evidence.
Invalid reproducibility inputs are conflated with genuine nonreproducibility.
Baseline is only a float, so candidate/baseline data/code/env/split/metric comparability cannot be verified.
Mutable lineage is blocked through literal sentinel words instead of requiring immutable identifiers.
The priority ranker is promoted using F1 without defining a binary classification construct/threshold that justifies F1 for the ordering objective.
Theory misdefines a model registry as an 'archivo'.
T1-A/T1-B/T2-A figures are misaligned with their instructional moment; T1-B alt text describes data/code/env that the actual figure does not draw.
approved=True is treated as approval evidence without reviewer, timestamp, review reference or candidate binding.
Promotion is a stage-string predicate rather than a versioned governed registry transition with auditable state.
Any string starting sha256: passes as a digest.
Four section-name tokens are treated as a complete model card.
Train/serve feature compatibility is reduced to equality of caller-supplied version strings.
Feature consistency uses one vector equality plus self-attested leakage=False and contract_tests>=3 rather than executed tests.
Prose permits rules or a previous model fallback while code accepts only rules-* names.
p95 and fallback testing are caller-supplied values/booleans rather than measured evidence.
Impossible/type-confused latency and batch inputs can pass.
The 1-64 batch limit is a magic capacity policy without profile evidence.
Canary validation accepts impossible negative metrics and a zero-exposure canary.
One traffic_pct conflates mirrored shadow traffic with user-visible response exposure.
Canary quality/error/hooks are not bound to metric definition, control, window, sample size or actual hook output.
Rollback readiness is self-attested; last_good need not exist/load/be healthy.
CF-4 audit trail is reduced to audit_entry=True.
Rollback safety is coupled to a nonempty retired set and exercises hard-code version 1.0.0.
Missing-first E3 routing masks already-known breaches in all eight subtopic families.
All 24 We Do exercises reuse almost the same predicate/valid-invalid-missing/router grammar.
E3 does not genuinely change context/representation for independent transfer.
You Do drops substantial T1-B/T2-B/T3-B/T4-A contracts from the mandatory path.
You Do compound breach masks rollback failure whenever canary also fails.
Residual risk is a hard-coded narrative instead of derived evidence.
Required commands, pinned dependencies and expected output are not part of executable acceptance.
15% security/privacy/least-privilege rubric criterion has no bound project evidence.
Four roadmap-mandated authentic topic evaluations are absent.
Eight fallback questions do not map one-per-subtopic; T1-B and T3-B are not directly assessed.
Legacy id opensource selects obsolete learner-facing packaging/CI playground content.
Dense mixed-language jargon and accessibility/redaction defects remain.
Resources rely too heavily on broad landing pages instead of direct primary references for high-risk contracts.

fixer_invariants: CF-4 PASS derives from immutable integrated evidence, never booleans/strings alone.
Baseline and candidate carry comparable lineage manifests; a bare baseline scalar is insufficient.
Run reproducibility distinguishes metric repeatability from full run reconstruction.
Artifact digest is recomputed/validated against bytes.
Approval is bound to the exact immutable candidate/review.
Feature parity is demonstrated by executed contract tests and point-in-time-safe definitions.
Latency/canary/rollback metrics are measured from runs; invalid domains are rejected.
Known breach is never hidden by missing unrelated evidence.
Rollback targets an existing loadable last-known-good and is actually drilled.
S47 consumes S44/S46 versioned evidence and closes CP-N4-B/CF-4 only after staging E2E and rollback pass.
Legacy id opensource remains compatibility-only and never selects obsolete lesson semantics.
note: Compact branch continuity manifest. Complete paragraph/exercise-level ledger with current content, observations, improved versions and justification is the current project conversation artifact S47.json and is integrity-bound by the SHA-256 above.
